## What's Changed
* Remove legacy fixture support from scenarios by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2657
* Remove the validate response value flag by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2656
* refactor: Remove the deprecated REST pattern operator by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2659
* Add path remapping support for Specmatic config by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2660
* fix: render before fixture  results info in studio when before fixtures fails by @vedubhat in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2661
* fix: main schema should override any member schema having the same property name from main schema during allOf parsing by @yogeshnikam671 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2662
* Select the most specific matching stub base URL by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2663
* refactor: tidy up internal list handling by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2665


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/compare/2.51.0...2.51.1
